personalities.description: Drawings balanced between firm lines and open curves reveal an adaptable spirit, able to learn, choose, and grow in many directions.
Drawings that flow with patient grace reveal a thoughtful spirit attentive to subtle change, living beauty, and long-held memories.
Drawings with a heavy, steady hand reveal deep patience, practical wisdom, and pride in shaping something that will endure.
Drawings that move in fluid, unbroken waves reveal a reflective spirit that adapts gracefully while holding fast to its deepest currents.
Drawings guided by instinctive rhythm reveal an open-hearted spirit, alert to its community and quick to answer a call for help.
Drawings that open into swift, airy arcs reveal a spirited nature drawn to freedom, fresh horizons, and fearless expression.
Drawings full of nimble turns reveal an adaptable, good-humored spirit that finds opportunity where others see a dead end.
Drawings anchored by deliberate, watchful lines reveal a composed survivor who trusts patience, preparation, and loyalty.
Drawings with a heavy weight and sense of intention bellow a deep calm...yet also a staunch responsibility.
Drawings with soft, flowing contours reveal a curious spirit able to adapt to new shapes without losing its essential self.
Drawings that hold their course through pale, broken traces reveal a reserved spirit with remarkable endurance and an unquiet resolve.
Drawings that persist through broken, uneven strokes reveal a tenacious spirit that has endured hardship without surrendering its purpose.
Drawings with daring angles and hidden turns reveal a perceptive, ambitious spirit that is unafraid to explore difficult truths.
Drawings with broad strokes and a grounded center reveal a calm presence, immense resolve, and a staunch sense of responsibility.
Drawings that sweep high and wide reveal a far-seeing spirit: confident in flight, yet mindful of the responsibility that comes with it.
Drawings arranged in exact sequences reveal a methodical mind that seeks consistency, clear purpose, and elegant solutions.
Drawings with a firm spine and restrained, rising curves reveal a determined spirit learning to balance inherited power with its own will.
Drawings with sturdy geometry and dependable strokes reveal a practical nature that prizes skill, endurance, and work well finished.
Drawings of sharp facets joined into a whole reveal a resilient spirit that turns fracture into character and difference into strength.
Drawings that connect careful points into a patient web reveal a resourceful spirit, observant, nimble, and always planning its next step.
Drawings with coiling, deliberate motion reveal an ancient patience and a keen sensitivity to the forces moving around you.
Drawings with a strong, watchful rhythm reveal a loyal protector: decisive when danger nears, calm when the pack is safe.
Drawings with commanding weight and measured force reveal a proud spirit that tempers great strength with discipline.
Drawings that leave deliberate spaces between their marks reveal a reflective spirit, carrying questions where others expect certainty.
Drawings built from precise repetitions and purposeful angles reveal a patient mind that finds strength in cooperation and detail.
Drawings that rise in clear, graceful arcs reveal a composed spirit guided by compassion, conviction, and a sense of duty.
Drawings that shift between open curves and sudden turns reveal an intuitive spirit, responsive to every change in its surroundings.
Drawings that fade at their edges yet hold a steady center reveal a quiet observer comfortable between presence and absence.
Drawings held within careful boundaries reveal a measured spirit that studies its limits and finds purpose in restraint.
Drawings that curl into playful loops reveal a clever, tender spirit that delights in discovery and sees wonder in small things.
Drawings marked by weathered angles and stubborn lines reveal a self-reliant spirit shaped by hardship and unwilling to yield.
Drawings that leap between lively curves and quick turns reveal an inventive, spirited nature that learns through curiosity and action.
Drawings that move close to the ground in cautious, searching lines reveal a patient survivor with an instinct for hidden paths.
Drawings traced in controlled, exact strokes reveal a precise and methodical spirit - one that values order, deliberate craft, and every piece in its proper place.
Your marks press inward with hungry, deliberate force: a will shaped by the harsh hierarchy of the demon realm, still at the beginning of its climb.
Your strokes curl and wander like a foxfire trail: curious, elusive, and attuned to hidden currents that others overlook.
Your lines mirror and return upon themselves, suggesting a resourceful spirit able to divide its presence and act from more than one place.
Your marks draw unlike forms into one design, revealing a tenacious spirit that can reconcile conflicting instincts within a single self.
Drawings that break their own rhythm, spontaneous, wild, and filled with sharp points, reveal a spirit that refuses to be confined to one path.

_comment: Combination outcomes begin with the values from the October 13 lookup. Construct, Random, and the four TR Nightmares races are curated overrides. The four new races use symbol combinations selected for thematic fit and narrative rarity. Keys are unordered and repeated symbols are allowed. Personality descriptions may be null to skip the personality line.
